items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Interviewer asks: 'Well, who was in that, that was Cornbread's band, right?' Interviewee responds by listing other band members (Joseph Thomas, Julius, Henry Ricksnell) but does not mention Cornbread or describe a personal interaction with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, most of them bring their baskets. Yeah, they bring their baskets.
Well, who was in that, that was Cornbread's band, right? Who was that?

Yeah, Joseph Thomas. Who was in the band? We used a fella called Julius, Julius on banjo, damn good banjo, sort of Jamaica bar. Henry Ricksnell, he's a male carter. He was a good man. He was the one who made Rene, Kid Rene, look like 15 cents. When this number, we got this number before them, music go round and round, because he was a smart fella. He was just like Blue.
